duplicate.title: Duplicate Assessment
duplicate.intro: A copy of “{{name}}” will be saved as a draft. Learners will not see it until you publish it. The original is not changed.
duplicate.questionsHint: All sections and questions. If off, the copy starts with no questions.
duplicate.markingHint: Marks and negative marking of every question. If off, every question gets 1 mark.
duplicate.scheduleHint: Filled in from the original. Set the dates for the new test.
duplicate.scheduleOptional: Leave empty to keep the original's dates.
duplicate.batchesHint: The copy is assigned to these {{term}}. You can change them here or later in the assessment.
duplicate.noBatches: No {{term}} selected. You can add participants later.
duplicate.individuals: Also add learners who were added one by one
duplicate.individualsHint: Learners added to the original individually, not through a {{term}}.
